Off-Plan Projects in Siora

Hado by Beyond

Hado by Beyond is a residential development planned within the Siora master community. The project will comprise three towers and will feature 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, along with 3 and 4-bedroom duplexes and select 4-bedroom simplex homes. Planned amenities include a pool deck, terrace garden, zen lounge, and fitness studio, supporting a balanced lifestyle aligned with Siora’s design philosophy.

Buying a Property in Siora

Properties for sale in Siora will form part of a master-planned residential community on the Dubai Islands. Already launched offerings include 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and duplexes, with additional residential projects expected to be introduced for buyers seeking long-term value and high-quality waterfront living.

Life in Siora revolves around a carefully balanced island lifestyle supported by nature-inspired design and everyday conveniences. Residents can expect a calm environment shaped by wellness, connectivity, and proximity to key city destinations.

Siora’s location on the Dubai Islands offers direct connectivity to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), supporting convenient travel to major business and leisure hubs. The community will be designed with internal road networks that complement pedestrian movement. Both private and public parking spaces will be present to support residents, visitors, and commercial users within the master-plan.

Dubai Mall, located around 20 minutes away, provides access to a wide range of luxury retail, entertainment venues, and dining experiences. Its proximity adds to the lifestyle appeal of living in Siora Dubai Islands.

Schools and Nurseries near Siora

Families living in Siora will have access to several early learning centers nearby. Options such as Green Leaves Early Childhood Center, Little Learners Early Learning Center, and Spectrum Nursery support early education needs within a short drive.

School-going children will benefit from nearby institutions, including Little Flower English School and Amna Bont Wahab Secondary Girls School. These schools add to the family-friendly appeal of the community.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Siora

Several mosques are located near Siora, supporting the spiritual needs of residents. Notable options include Al Rahma Mosque and Al Futtaim Mosque, both accessible within a short drive.
Hindu temples are also present within easy access, including the Shree Krishna Haveli and the Shiva Temple in Bur Dubai. These established places of worship remain within convenient reach of the community.

Churches near Siora include St. Mary’s Catholic Church and Holy Trinity Church, both located in Bur Dubai and reachable within a convenient driving distance.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Siora

Healthcare facilities near Siora include Dubai Hospital, located approximately 15 minutes away, and Al Kuwait Hospital, reachable in around 20 minutes. These medical centers will support access to routine and emergency healthcare services for future residents.

Siora Location & Nearby Areas

Siora’s location on the Dubai Islands places it close to established areas such as Deira, Al Satwa, Al Jaddaf, and Dubai Festival City. These nearby districts will provide access to commercial hubs, cultural landmarks, and lifestyle destinations within a short drive.

Siora will offer a range of community-focused amenities designed to support relaxation, wellness, and social interaction. The master-plan’s emphasis on open spaces and walkability will shape everyday activities within the community.

Siora Restaurants

Residents of Siora will find several dining options nearby, including Sands Beach Club, Rayyan Mandi, and Hyatt Summer Palace Restaurant. These venues cater to casual and family dining experiences. As the community develops, more retail and dining options are expected to be introduced for residents.

Beaches near Siora

Siora will offer easy access to the beaches of the Dubai Islands, supporting a relaxed coastal lifestyle. Deira Island Beach, also called Dubai Islands Beach, will be among the nearby beachfront destinations accessible to residents and visitors.

Hotels near Siora

Hotel Riu Dubai is a beachfront, all-inclusive resort on the Dubai Islands, offering multiple dining venues, swimming pools, leisure facilities, and direct beach access. It adds a vibrant hospitality presence close to Siora Dubai Islands.

Centara Mirage Beach Resort Dubai is a family-focused beachfront resort featuring themed attractions, water play areas, dining outlets, and wellness facilities. Located on the Dubai Islands, it complements the leisure and lifestyle offerings near Siora.

Nearby Attractions and Landmarks

Dubai Gold Souk, accessible within a 20-minute drive, is known for its traditional retail atmosphere and extensive selection of gold and jewelry outlets. It remains one of Dubai’s most iconic commercial landmarks.

Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood will offer cultural and heritage experiences within a similar driving distance. The area features museums, art spaces, and preserved architecture that reflect Dubai’s past.
Zabeel Park, also reachable within 20 minutes, provides open recreational spaces, jogging tracks, and family-friendly facilities. The park serves as a green escape close to the city’s core.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Siora is designed to promote an active and balanced lifestyle through its open spaces, landscaped walkways, and pedestrian-friendly environment. Residents will be encouraged to enjoy outdoor movement, relaxation, and social interaction within the community’s nature-inspired setting.

As the master community develops, dedicated fitness facilities and wellness-focused amenities will be introduced. In addition, gyms, fitness studios, and beauty salons for both men and women will be available in nearby areas, ensuring convenient access to health, wellness, and personal care services.

Siora will offer a balanced coastal lifestyle defined by open spaces, thoughtful design, and future connectivity. One point to consider is that the community is off-plan, meaning some facilities will be delivered in phases. However, this phased development allows the master-plan to evolve thoughtfully while maintaining long-term quality and value.

data.content:
Siora is a well-planned master community, located on the Dubai Islands, positioned close to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) for smooth connectivity across the city. Developed by Beyond Developments, this destination is envisioned as a future-forward address that balances design, nature, and everyday living. The community will form part of a wider master-plan shaped around meaningful urban experiences.

Inspired by Japanese garden principles and the pursuit of ikigai, Siora by Beyond will emphasize harmony, purpose, and well-being in daily life. The master community will span over 2 million sq. ft. of land area, with approximately 2.7 million sq. ft. of gross floor area, reflecting a carefully structured layout. More than 70% of the master-plan will be dedicated to open green spaces, reinforcing a calm and people-centric environment.

Designed as a pedestrian-friendly master district, Siora Dubai Islands will integrate landscaped pathways, shaded routes, and community-focused amenities drawn directly from the official master-plan. The development is home to Hado by Beyond, a residential project that introduces refined living within the wider Siora vision. Together, these elements position Siora as a thoughtfully planned residential destination on the Dubai Islands.
